data.content:
## Build Failure Diagnosis

**Solution:** `BuildDiag.sln` (3 projects: `Core`, `Services`, `Api`)

### Root Cause (1 issue, all errors cascade from it)

**Missing NuGet package reference in `Services/Services.csproj`**

`Services/UserService.cs` uses `Newtonsoft.Json` (lines 2-3: `using Newtonsoft.Json;` / `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;`, line 22: `JObject`), but the project file has **no `PackageReference` for `Newtonsoft.Json`**. The `project.assets.json` confirms only `Core/1.0.0` is resolved — no external packages.

All 3 errors are manifestations of this single root cause:
| Error | File | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(2,7) | `Newtonsoft` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(3,7) | `Newtonsoft` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(22,19) | `JObject` type not found |

### Cascading Failures

`Api.csproj` depends on `Services.csproj`. While MSBuild didn't emit additional errors for `Api` in this log (it may have short-circuited), fixing `Services` is required for the entire solution to build.

### Fix

Add the `Newtonsoft.Json` package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <ProjectReference Include="..\Core\Core.csproj" />
</ItemGroup>
+<ItemGroup>
+  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
+</ItemGroup>
```

Then run `dotnet restore` and rebuild.
